title: scFragTrace: single-cell chromatin footprints for cancer detection and tissue-of-origin inference from low-coverage cell-free DNA (code)
description: Code accompanying the scFragTrace article. It derives cfDNA fragment features at single-cell ATAC-seq lineage sites, builds a label-free tissue-of-origin model from lineage footprints and copy-number templates (47 features, free of trained parameters), and trains a lineage-constrained graph network and a five-component cancer score on a single discovery cohort (Cristiano et al. 2019). Includes the trained parameters, a worked example on open-access samples (Snyder et al. 2016, GEO GSE71378), and the single-cell reference site sets and co-accessibility graph.
